answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一页两张独立图表。上图 CHART FFO-A：四条平滑无标记的折线（无数据点标记），左值轴 0.0–700.0（一位小数刻度、只有横向网格），横轴为 13 个裸月份缩写 Mar…Mar（首尾同名，跨两个财年），图例排在绘图区右侧成一列。下图 CHART FFO-B：7 组双色柱（2024/2025），轴 0–1200 步长 150，类别标签换行成最多四行（"Social insurance and retirement receipts"），图例在图下方，注记 "*Prior-year data are for the comparable year" 位于轴标签与图例之间。标题块须拆成编号行 "CHART FFO-A.—"、标题行与单位行 "(In billions of dollars)"。

## 定位一个值难在哪
取 140：它落在 FFO-A 最右端 Mar 的 Off-budget outlays 上。图上无任何数字，网格间距 100，而 5% 容差只有 ±7；同一区域 Off-budget receipts 与 outlays 两条线在 90–140 间互相缠绕，且横轴两端都写 "Mar"，行标签 "Off-budget outlays / Mar" 无法唯一定位。

## 不确定的
90 与 140 归属哪条线只能按曲线走向猜；35 可能是 Excise taxes 也可能是 Custom duties 的 2024 柱，两者都在 30–45 之间。FFO-B 没有任何单位文字，是否也是十亿美元只能推测。

worked_example.why_hard: No markers or printed values; smoothed spline peak between gridlines spaced 100 apart

heading.title: Budget Receipts by Source, Fiscal Year to Date, 2024-2025

worked_example.why_hard: Bar is ~4 px tall against ticks spaced 150; 5% tolerance is under 2 units

components.evidence: Two captioned charts, 'CHART FFO-A.—' and 'CHART FFO-B.—', stacked on one page
Blue and red bars side by side in each of seven category slots
Four legend entries in a right-hand column level with the plot, each with a colour rule
'2024  2025' swatches centred below the category labels and note
Horizontal rules at 100.0 intervals across the panel; no vertical rules
Horizontal rules at 150 intervals; no vertical rules
'(In billions of dollars)' under the title; y axis shows bare 0.0 ... 700.0
'Social insurance and retirement receipts' wraps onto four lines under the axis
Ticks read 'Mar Apr May Jun ... Feb Mar' with no year attached
'*Prior-year data are for the comparable year' printed under the category axis

new_components.name: repeated_time_tick_ambiguity
new_components.evidence: 'Mar' appears as both the first and last tick, spanning two fiscal years

new_components.name: smoothed_line_no_markers
new_components.evidence: All four series drawn as smoothed splines with no point markers at the month ticks

new_components.name: decimal_tick_labels
new_components.evidence: Y ticks printed '0.0, 100.0, ... 700.0' with a trailing decimal on whole hundreds

new_components.name: unit_absent_on_figure
new_components.evidence: No unit phrase anywhere; axis reads bare 0 ... 1200 and title names no scale

spot_checks.mark: the Apr peak of the On-budget receipts line
the Aug peak of the On-budget outlays line
the final Mar point of the Off-budget outlays line
a trough near Dec among the Off-budget lines; which of the two lines is unclear
the 2025 bar of Individual income taxes
the 2024 bar of Social insurance and retirement receipts
the 2025 bar of Corporate income taxes
a short 2024 bar among Excise taxes / Custom duties; the two are indistinguishable in height

answer.hardest_step_why: 两图全无数值标签：140 的5%容差仅±7，而网格间距100；35 的容差不足2，柱高仅几像素。

examples.quote: Y ticks 0.0 to 700.0 in steps of 100.0; four unlabelled smoothed lines, two clustered near 100
examples.why: 接近100的两条线无法读到±7；可读性须按每个标记给出可达精度，而非全图一刀切。

examples.quote: 'CHART FFO-A.—' / 'Monthly Receipts and Outlays, 2024-2025' / '(In billions of dollars)'
examples.why: 编号行、标题行、括号单位行三行分立，现有流水线不把单位当作独立标题字段输出。

examples.quote: Y ticks '0, 150, 300, ... 1200'; note '*Prior-year data are for the comparable year' above the legend
examples.why: 刻度步长150、无单位、注记夹在轴标签与图例之间，均属未被建模的样式维度。

examples.quote: The x axis reads 'Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec Jan Feb Mar'
examples.why: 首尾同名刻度跨两财年，行键需带年份消歧；建议时间轴键增加周期消歧字段。
